findings.statement: The proposed aggregate-memory and heterogeneity equation improves reserved-condition two-second rotation prediction over all matched controls.

reliability.rationale: The positive proposed claim is not admitted. The selected forecast has condition-mean MAE 0.0659579 in signed polarization, worse than current-state persistence 0.0657186 and flexible 0.0647465. Worst-condition error also fails to improve on persistence. Unsupported predictive superiority and a supported informative failure are appropriate.

mechanism.rationale: Position-derived causal polarization is a collective geometric response, not a measurement of a universal individual turning tendency. Country-condition repetitions are linked, but participant reuse across conditions is unknown; trial calibration and only five held conditions limit transfer.

novelty.rationale: Known source analyses and standard mathematical/statistical families are disclosed. This review does not certify a new law or exhaustive novelty.
